classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round is bracketed by barrier.wait() before and after the _read_staged of class_a(workdir, r, placing), so every rank is held at the synchronisation point while that one shared per-round file is read, and each rank reads a given round's file exactly once.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Each rank synchronously _read's its own class_b(workdir, me, i) files after the barrier while other ranks do their own private reads, and the loop over cell.class_bs_per_rank sits inside the 200-round loop so each file is read once per round.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: The per-rank class_c(workdir, me, i, placing) reads are blocking _read calls made after the barrier is passed, private to the reading rank, and repeated in every one of the cell.rounds=200 iterations.
